---
title: "Valid options"
filters:
  - panzoom
panzoom:
  match: auto
  max-zoom: 6
  hint: false
  caption: true
  loop: true
  fit: contain
  css-class: my-viewer
  backdrop: "#000"
  caption-background: "#111"
  caption-color: "rgb(230, 230, 230)"
  link-color: "#9cf"
expect-errors: []
---

Every option, with a valid value: the page must render, with no errors.

```{r}
#| panzoom:
#|   max-zoom: 8
#|   hint: true
#|   caption: false
#|   group: walks
#|   fit: width
#|   description: "A plot, with $x^2$ in its description."
plot(cumsum(rnorm(50)), type = "l")
```

```{r}
#| panzoom: false
plot(1)
```
